name: Together AI
summary: Cloud for open-weight models: serve popular checkpoints, fine-tune them, and rent raw GPU capacity when needed.
description:
Together sits in the useful middle — you get an OpenAI-shaped API over a long catalogue of open models without running anything, and the same account offers fine-tuning and dedicated endpoints when a shared deployment stops being predictable. When a new open checkpoint lands, it is usually servable there within days, which is the practical definition of staying current.

Pricing per million tokens hides the important variable: shared endpoints have noisy latency under load, so a user-facing feature should be tested at your peak rather than at yours alone. The GPU-rental layer is a different product with different operational expectations, and teams often discover that gap mid-migration.
